items.quote: the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac
items.claim: The LORD appeared to Jacob and identified himself as God of Abraham and Isaac

items.quote: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed
items.claim: The land will be given to Jacob and his descendants

items.quote: thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth
items.claim: Jacob's descendants will multiply to be as numerous as dust of the earth

items.quote: thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south
items.claim: Jacob's descendants will spread geographically in all cardinal directions
items.place: to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south

items.quote: in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed
items.claim: All families of the earth will be blessed through Jacob and his descendants
items.actor: all the families of the earth
items.mechanism: in thee and in thy seed
